generation.reference_description: Generated revision4 energy crescent; rejected predecessor/reference retained privately, not included as a production artifact.
generation.prompt: Modify this game energy crescent to remove its solid green bean/plastic look. Keep EXACT same crescent silhouette, extent, position, shape and green hue, but change opacity and illumination: remove all dark opaque green rim. Across the outermost25percent of ribbon thickness, smoothly fade alpha to zero INSIDE the current bounds, with bright green translucent edges, not black or dark-green outline. Leave center luminous vivid green, no white/yellow/cyan. Flat luminous energy ribbon, not a lit3D solid object: no bevel, no shaded cylindrical volume, no specular highlight. It must merge softly with light cyan clouds as well as dark brown ground when composited, without a dark contour. No external halo beyond current silhouette. Use actual partial transparency, not painted black fading. Transparent PNG background, no text or extra objects. Keep original dimensions.

reconstruction.paste_operation: straight RGBA paste onto transparent canvas
reconstruction.mirror44: exact horizontal flip of full registered96x112 ID6 canvas

selection.scope: Offline native2x/4x cloud/brown composite pilot selection for6/44 only; engine appearance requires separate review.
selection.extent: Same fixed proportional registration as revision4, modestly narrower than original. No anisotropic stretch or footprint expansion.
selection.alpha: Bright translucent edge with interior alpha fade; no opaque dark-green rim. No procedural repaint/recolor/threshold.
